plan: This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). In such auctions, bidding my true value is the dominant strategy - it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies. Bidding higher than my value risks paying more than the item is worth to me, while bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With my value at $13, I'll bid exactly $13 to ensure I only win when profitable and capture maximum surplus when I do.

Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth if I win against a bid between my value and my bid. Bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Since my value is $15, I will bid $15 to maximize expected profit, letting the auction mechanism naturally determine my payment based on competitors' bids.
